conditions: This applies to the BEGIN-PROCEDURE forms and variable markers documented for SQR for PeopleSoft in the October 2022 PeopleTools 8.60 reference.
Ordinary declarations here use the applicable variable marker without the documented global underscore prefix.
limitations: The global spelling applies to the three named variable markers, subject to the declaration and reference rules for each marker.
The chapter assigns a separate purpose to the colon prefix on procedure arguments returned to a caller. Variable retention and query column-binding rules are separate.

triggers: Vendor correction, version remapping, source byte drift, or contrary primary evidence.

statement: Oracle documents a procedure as local when its BEGIN-PROCEDURE header places LOCAL after its name or declares arguments. Ordinary variable declarations in a local procedure have procedure scope. The documented spelling for declaring or referencing a global variable from a local procedure places an underscore immediately after its initial $, #, or & marker.
